query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.role, u.custom_role_id, cr.name as custom_role_name
FROM user u
LEFT JOIN custom_roles cr ON u.custom_role_id = cr.id
WHERE u.role = 'manutencao' OR u.name LIKE '%manut%';
